notes: Game Bot V0.03: the build bar and status now show what Unity is doing - e.g. Compiling shaders: 83/2304 (first build is slow, this is normal), the file being imported, or the player build step. Rising shader progress counts as activity, so a slow first build is never mistaken for a hang. Includes V0.02 fixes (status-only eta/eat/?, known-bad import skip, hang reports that ask before sending).
